crossRefs.note: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.

people.name: Benaiah
people.line: A Pirathonite, one of David's mighty warriors.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Pirathon
people.line: A town in Ephraim, home of several notable Israelites

translations.web: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translations.bsb: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
translations.kjv: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
translations.asv: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
